verify_points.desc: Diagnostics-enabled showreel export writes a structured JSON report with duration, frame count, average ms/frame, slow spans, top frames, warnings, and artifact paths.
Desktop inspector shows a 24s performance map with slow spans highlighted and selectable.
Export status/result UI includes diagnostics summary and report path while preserving the open video action.
Diagnostics mode does not regress normal export: MP4 remains 24s with AAC audio, burned-in subtitles, and no residual export processes.

items.title: Recorder and nf export diagnostics JSON

ai_tools.expected: export succeeds and final JSON includes diagnostics_path
diagnostics report has non-empty timing fields and arrays
succeeded response includes diagnostics.summary and diagnostics.path

items.title: Inspector performance map and diagnostics summary

ai_tools.expected: outerHTML contains performance map segments and report path
desktop PNG shows export diagnostics summary and slow span map

ai_tools.command: ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -select_streams a:0 -show_entries stream=codec_name -of json ../NextFrame.archive/v0.16.0-verify/showreel-24s-diagnostics.mp4
ai_tools.expected: duration is close to 24s and audio codec is aac
captured frame contains burned-in subtitle text
no residual export or recorder process remains
